Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: System Event Messages is used to signal key market or data feed control events.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: System Event Codes

Message.Name: Trade Report Message
Message.Description: The following message is used to relay trade transactions that are reported for the current business day. Please note that Nasdaq only reports one-side of a trade execution on the Last Sale feeds.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Client Timestamp
Field.Description: TRF Reported timestamp. Set to 0 for non-TRF trades.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq market system that generated the trade report message.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq-assigned issue symbol of the security for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Price
Field.Description: Denotes the report price on the trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Size
Field.Description: Indicates the reported number of shares on the trade transaction.

Field.Name: Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Denotes the settlement type of the transaction.

Field.Name: Consolidated Volume
Field.Description: Reflects the volume for the Issue Symbol as reported on the consolidated market data feed at the time that the trade message was generated.

Message.Name: Trade Cancel Error Message
Message.Description: The following message is used in the event that a transaction is cancelled on the same business day that it is reported.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Client Timestamp
Field.Description: TRF Reported timestamp. Set to 0 for non-TRF trades.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq market system that generated the trade report and cancel/error message.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq-assigned issue symbol of the security for which the trade report is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Original Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Price
Field.Description: Reported price for the transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Size
Field.Description: Reported number of shares for transaction.

Field.Name: Original Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Defines the sale condition modifiers as reported on the original trade transaction.

Field.Name: Consolidated Volume
Field.Description: Reflects the volume for the Issue Symbol as reported on the consolidated market data feed at the time that the trade cancel/error message was generated.

Message.Name: Trade Correction Message
Message.Description: The following message is used in the event that a trade transaction is corrected on the same business day that it is reported.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Client Timestamp
Field.Description: TRF Reported timestamp. Set to 0 for non-TRF trades.

Field.Name: Originating Market Center Identifier
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq market system that generated the trade report and cancel/error message.

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the Nasdaq-assigned issue symbol of the security for which the trade correction message is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Original Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the source's internal control number associated with the given trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Price
Field.Description: Reported price on the original trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Trade Size
Field.Description: Reported number of shares on the original trade transaction.

Field.Name: Original Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Indicates sale condition modifiers associated with the original transaction.

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Control Number
Field.Description: Indicates the Nasdaq internal control number associated with the adjusted trade transaction.

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Price
Field.Description: Indicates the price for the corrected trade transaction.

Field.Name: Corrected Trade Size
Field.Description: Indicates the number of shares for the corrected trade transaction.

Field.Name: Corrected Sale Condition Modifier
Field.Description: Denotes the sale condition modifiers associated with the corrected trade transaction.

Field.Name: Consolidated Volume
Field.Description: Reflects the volume for the Issue Symbol as reported on the consolidated market data feed at the time that the trade correction message was generated.

Message.Name: Stock Trading Action Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of a security to the trading community.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Nasdaq-assigned indicator for issue for which the trading action message is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Reflects the current trading state for the issue.

Field.Name: Reason
Field.Description: Reflects the Market Ops or Market Watch code for the trading state change.

Message.Name: Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restricted Indicator Message
Message.Description: Nasdaq processes orders based on the most Reg SHO Restriction status value.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Nasdaq-assigned indicator for issue for which the short sale restriction indicator message is being generated.

Field.Name: Reg SHO Action
Field.Description: Denotes the Reg SHO Short Sale Price Test Restriction status for the issue at the time of the message dissemination.

Message.Name: Stock Directory Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates stock directory messages for all active Nasdaq and non Nasdaq listed security symbols.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Stock
Field.Description: Denotes the security symbol for the issue in the Nasdaq execution system.

Field.Name: Market Category
Field.Description: Indicates listing market or listing market tier for the issue.

Field.Name: Financial Status Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates when a firm is not in compliance with Nasdaq continued listing requirements.

Field.Name: Round Lot Size
Field.Description: Denotes the number of shares that represent a round lot for the issue.

Field.Name: Round Lots Only
Field.Description: Indicates if Nasdaq system limits order entry for issue.

Field.Name: Issue Classification
Field.Description: Identifies the security class for the issue as assigned by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Issue Sub Type
Field.Description: Identifies the security sub-type for the issue as assigned by Nasdaq.

Field.Name: Authenticity
Field.Description: Denotes if an issue or quoting participant record is set-up in Nasdaq systems in a live/production, test, or demo state.

Field.Name: Short Sale Threshold Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates if a security is subject to mandatory close-out of short sales under SEC Rule 203(b)(3).

Field.Name: IPO Flag
Field.Description: Indicates if the Nasdaq security is set up for IPO release.

Field.Name: LULD Reference Price Tier
Field.Description: Indicates which Limit Up / Limit Down price band calculation parameter is to be used for the instrument.

Field.Name: ETP Flag
Field.Description: Indicates whether the security is an exchange traded product.

Field.Name: ETP Leverage Factor
Field.Description: Tracks the integral relationship of the ETP to the underlying index.

Field.Name: Inverse Indicator
Field.Description: Indicates the directional relationship between the ETP and underlying index.

Field.Name: Bloomberg ID
Field.Description: The composite ID that Bloomberg has assigned to the security.

Message.Name: Adjusted Closing Price Message
Message.Description: At the start of each trading day, Nasdaq disseminates the adjusted closing price for all active symbols in the Nasdaq system.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Nasdaq-assigned indicator for the issue.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Indicates the primary listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Adjusted Closing Price
Field.Description: The previous trading day's official closing price adjusted for any applicable corporate actions.

Message.Name: End of Day Trade Summary Message
Message.Description: At the close of each trading day, Nasdaq will disseminate end of day trade summary messages for all active Nasdaq- and non-Nasdaq-listed securities.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Nasdaq internal tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Timestamp

Field.Name: Issue Symbol
Field.Description: Nasdaq-assigned indicator for issue for which the directory message is being generated.

Field.Name: Security Class
Field.Description: Denotes the listing market for the issue.

Field.Name: Consolidated High Price
Field.Description: The highest price of any high/low eligible transaction on Tapes A, B or C received on the trading day.

Field.Name: Consolidated Low Price
Field.Description: The lowest price of any high/low eligible transaction on Tapes A, B or C received on the trading day.

Field.Name: Consolidated Closing Price
Field.Description: The final last sale eligible transaction on Tapes A, B or C received on the trading day.

Field.Name: Consolidated Volume
Field.Description: Reflects the total volume for the issue reported at the consolidated market level.

Field.Name: Consolidated Open Price
Field.Description: The first last sale eligible transactions received on the trading day for Tapes A, B or C.
